seo.title: Packing List for East Java - JVTO Travel Guide
seo.description: What to bring to Bromo, Ijen, and Tumpak Sewu: clothing layers, headlamp, footwear, equipment, and personal items for East Java's tropical-to-alpine climate.

page.title: Packing List for East Java
page.summary: Packing list for East Java volcano and waterfall routes: clothing layers, footwear, equipment, personal medical items, and destination temperature context.

hero.heading: What to pack for East Java.
hero.lede: East Java spans tropical lowlands and 2,300+ metre volcanic rims in one trip. Layers, grip, and a headlamp are non-negotiable.

payload.intro: Most travelers underpack for the cold, overpack for the heat, and forget the headlamp. This list fixes that.

sections.title: Clothing - base layers
items: Thermal long-sleeve top (merino or synthetic, not cotton)
Hiking pants x 2 (one quick-dry, one warm)

sections.title: Clothing - outer layers
items: Buff or neck scarf for sulfur protection at Ijen

sections.title: Footwear
items: Trail running shoes or light hiking shoes with grip
Sandals for lodge or clinic visits

sections.title: Equipment
items: Dry bag for phone and wallet at Tumpak Sewu
Universal travel adapter for Indonesia Type C/F

sections.title: Personal and medical
items: Personal medication for the full course plus 3 days buffer
Lip balm for dry rim air
